Project.name: frontend-livecoding-tasks
Project.annotation: ARMY-97 replaces the legacy card library with immutable task-ID interview practice.

UC-ARMY97-PRACTICE.Action: Open a thematic task or a static interview simulation.
UC-ARMY97-PRACTICE.AcceptanceCriteria: Every card is self-contained and every simulation is a plausible mixed frontend interview.

UC-ARMY97-PUBLISH.Action: Turn an accepted candidate into a card.
UC-ARMY97-PUBLISH.AcceptanceCriteria: Only accepted candidates receive an immutable task-XXXX path and one thematic projection.

Constraints.constraint-immutable-id: Every published task is tasks/task-XXXX/README.md; the same immutable task-XXXX prefix is visible in its H1 and every task link, never reused, and never renumbered.
Constraints.constraint-card-contract: Card order is title, technology-mapped exact sandbox line, Условие, starter comments containing every requirement, three closed hints, closed solution, and closed five-field metadata whose duration is exactly N минут.
Constraints.constraint-provenance: No student-facing card, collection, root page, or simulation contains authorship, source provenance, import, or migration language. Task cards also omit fixture vocabulary and redundant negative environment wording while retaining positive runtime assumptions in the sandbox transfer instruction.
Constraints.constraint-catalog: The cutover catalog contains exactly task-0001 through task-0118 under four master indexes and exactly twenty-three registered topic pages covering JavaScript 92, TypeScript 8, React 16, and HTML/CSS 2. Master pages list topic pages only with exact counts; every card has one Master → Topic metadata owner and one topic row using ordinal, exact visible-ID card link and title, difficulty, N минут duration, and one substantive sentence.
Constraints.constraint-simulations: Exactly thirty static mixed simulations contain exactly three task rows from at least three registered topics, satisfy 30-120 minutes and exact card-duration sums, pass the three-simulation recurrence rule, and record substantive realism evidence.
Constraints.constraint-validation: Tracked immutable candidate hash, current Markdown inventory, canonical duration, technology/editor mapping synchronized with frozen Beads card metadata, exact collection-row content, derived publication decisions, exact CardMigrationEvidence whose slug exists in the executed commit, and causal mode-bound FullCatalogGateEvidence emitted and re-verified only after the complete final catalog gate passes at current HEAD precede XML, Grace, and diff checks; nested collection provenance scanning remains Bash 3 compatible.

NonGoals.item-1: No browser, target-editor, GitHub-rendering, or CSS-layout gate.
